art_style: Cut-paper geometric construction with restrained sumi-e and seal-print accents; preserve the one-color silhouette.

emblem.reason: Seal and origami motifs form a compact game emblem.

abstract mark.reason: Motion and fold geometry suggest elemental transformation.

pictorial mark.reason: A folded creature or tower can signal the genre.

wordmark.reason: A complementary readable title is useful in the header, but not the lead small icon.

mascot.reason: A single creature risks narrowing a five-element tower-defense identity.

concepts.art_style: Geometric folded-paper silhouette and restrained carved seal impression
concepts.example: A single angular folded-paper core with a small square negative-space seal, enclosed by an incomplete circular ink impression; one crease breaks the ring to suggest motion.
concepts.rationale: Directly joins origami, seals and elemental transformation. A simplified silhouette can survive at favicon size. Avoid fine brush texture in small marks.

concepts.art_style: Angular paper planes arranged in a spiral
concepts.example: Three broad paper facets pivot around a central void to form a compact rotating storm; crease geometry implies a folded paper object rather than a generic wind icon.
concepts.rationale: Expresses motion and transformation, with strong one-color performance. The seal motif may be less immediate.

concepts.art_style: Cut-paper fortress silhouette in a restrained stamp frame
concepts.example: A folded tower rises from a small square seal frame with one folded corner and two broad defensive tiers.
concepts.rationale: Communicates tower defense instantly, but could resemble a generic castle or stamp; fine details must be avoided.

concepts.art_style: Origami crane constructed from a few large angular facets
concepts.example: A soaring crane with an ink-ring trail, its folded wings forming an abstract S-shaped motion.
concepts.rationale: Strong paper-craft symbolism but may imply an air-only game and resemble familiar origami crane marks.

selection_reason: Highest provisional weighted score: combines fold and seal symbolism with clear one-color silhouette; agent recommendation only, awaiting owner review.
